subject: Beta feedback - changing user email address

messages.author: ce4d07dca278fde0
messages.subject: Beta feedback - changing user email address
parts:
Hi, some more feedback regarding beta / general availability features. It would be good to have an option to change a user account's email address. At the moment this option is greyed out when updating user profile details.

Best regards,
Lukas

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Beta feedback - changing user email address
parts:
Thanks Lukas,
When you mean change, you really mean you want a way to transfer the ownership of the account from one email address to another, is that the case?

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Beta feedback - changing user email address
parts:
Thanks for the response. Yes - in my case I just used a different gmail address when I first signed up, and then couldn't change it. I still have access to both gmail accounts so it's not a big deal.

But I could see this being an issue for users who switch organizations and lose access to an institutional email address - for example a student might have signed up with a university email address, and would like to update their user details / email address when they lose the university email account at the end of their studies.
